text:
Maria: Heads-up — during bringup of reranker-v2 (PTQ-int8, mixed-quant) I see a consistent NDCG@10 drop ~1.4 pts on the holdout compared to staging. MRR tiny change but not the same direction :thinking:
Taylor: rough numbers? which holdout and how big is the sample?
Maria: holdout=last_7days_prodlike, sample=10k queries stratified by length. staging eval uses 50k sampled last_month. seeds: 42/43. Run command: `./eval_rerank --model reranker-v2 --quant ptq-int8 --seed 42 --holdout last_7days_prodlike --candidates 100`
Kevin: any candidate ordering nondeterminism? we've seen anchor ordering cause ndcg jitter before.
Maria: candidates are from upstream retrieval, stable sort by score, but retrieval version was bumped. I re-ran with pinned retrieval commit and same drop persists.
Irene: did you check tokenizer parity between train and eval? subtle tokenization shifts killed us last time.
Maria: good point — tokenizer v1 vs v1.1 mismatch on whitespace. Re-ran with canonical tokenizer and saw ~0.3 pt improvement but still ~1.1 pt drop.
Taylor: is this visible across query-length slices? long vs short?
Maria: short queries (<10 tokens) stable. mid (10-40) biggest drop ~1.8 pts. long (>40) noise due to fewer samples.
Irene: could be priming/priming-length changes — did you include the same prompt template?
Maria: yes same prompt template. Also tried disabling prefix-caching and batching differences; negligible effect.
Kevin: CI/ops side — can you dump the exact eval harness env (python deps, torch/cuda, quant backends)? CI Bot: `eval-harness@runner` started job 1788889999-1: env snapshot: torch 2.2.0+cu118, bitsandbytes 0.40, rust-kvpack v1.4, tokenizers 0.13.3
Maria: added more seeds (10 seeds) and averaged: mean NDCG delta ~-1.2 pts, stdev 0.15. so consistent across seeds.
Irene: sounds like a systematic regression, not a seed fluke. Next steps: 1) run AB with model variant (fp16 non-quant) on same holdout, 2) run candidate-rescoring sanity with golden queries, 3) check retrieval candidate distribution change.
Taylor: propose a quick smoke CI that compares NDCG over a fixed small golden set (2k queries) pre/post deploy and flags >0.5 pt regression.
Kevin: +1 for golden set. Also let's pin retrieval commit in the bringup job so we can isolate model vs retrieval.
Maria: I'll kick off fp16 vs int8 on the exact pinned retrieval commit and post results here.
Irene: if fp16 matches staging and int8 doesn't, dig into quant kernel differences and per-slice calibration. Might be per-slice calibration drift for mid-length queries.
Maria: initial upload link to logs: https://redwood-internal/seq/1788889999/logs — will post summaries in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Taylor: thanks — if you see large per-query archetypes failing we can pull a small human eval to sanity-check label alignment.
Maria: noted, will add small human spot-check next round.
CI Bot: job 1788889999-1 completed: fp16 run NDCG delta vs staging: -0.2 pts; int8 run NDCG delta: -1.15 pts. Artifacts at https://artifacts/redwood/1788889999/
Maria: early signal points to quant (int8) specific degradation. Starting per-layer sensitivity trace now.
Irene: great. keep thread for triage; let's avoid changing evaluation sampling protocol until we root cause. :white_check_mark:
